import subprocess, json

# Search arxiv for multimodal RAG papers
curl_cmd = "curl -s 'https://api.arxiv.org/search/query?query=multimodal+RAG&search_type=all&start=0&max_results=10&sort=last-updated'"
result = subprocess.run(curl_cmd, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
papers_data = json.loads(result.stdout)

# Extract papers
entries = papers_data.get("response", {}).get("entry", [])

# Build markdown content
md_lines = [
    "# Research: Multimodal RAG Papers",
    "",
    "## Comparison Table",
    "| Year | Method | Key Finding |",
    "|------|--------|-------------|",
]

# Simple extraction for each paper
for paper in entries[:5]:
    title = paper.get("title", [""])[0]
    year = paper.get("year", "")
    authors = " / ".join(a["name"] for a in paper.get("authors", []))
    summary = paper.get("summary", "")[:150].replace("\n", " ")
    md_lines.append(f"| {year} | {authors} | {title} |")
    md_lines.append(f"| {summary} |")
    md_lines.append("")

md_content = "\n".join(md_lines)

# Write to file
with open("research.md", "w") as f:
    f.write(md_content)

print(f"Research.md created with {len(entries)} papers")
